info.prompt: Extreme close-up of a rogue's {bone-white|gilded} dice hand hovering over a {neon-slicked|blood-amber} game tile, the HUD edges flaring {poison-green|bardic purple} with class abilities, every pip and glyph rendered in {specimen-glass clarity|cracked monitor distortion}, background dissolving into {oscilloscope waveforms|hacked security feed} and {gothic stonework|server rack cathedral} ruins, depth-of-field so shallow only the {knuckle tattoos|cybernetic rings} stay crisp.
